figure: FIGURE 11.1 (Discrete vs continuous batching, Orca-style slot diagram)
issue: The caption misdescribes the row entity, contradicting the figure's own in-annotations and the right-panel semantics. Caption text: 'each row is one decode step, and in the continuous panel the step boundaries are staggered across rows'. But the in-figure note reads 'every shown request is in the per-token decode phase', the legend defines rows' contents as 'sequence in flight' / 'new sequence (backfill)', the right-panel annotation says 'a finishing sequence frees its slot immediately', and the caption's own later clause ('a batch is locked until its slowest member finishes, so short outputs idle in the trailing slots'; 'free slots are refilled every step') is only coherent if each row is a request/slot, not a single step. A row cannot simultaneously be 'one decode step' and carry a per-sequence blue-then-pink life cycle; 'step boundaries staggered across rows' is also incoherent because a decode step is a global time interval that cannot be staggered per row.
evidence: Quoted caption clause: 'each row is one decode step' and 'the step boundaries are staggered across rows'. Quoted in-figure note: 'every shown request is in the per-token decode phase'. Quoted right-panel labels: 'sequence in flight', 'new sequence (backfill)', 'a finishing sequence frees its slot immediately', 'new sequences (green) snap into freed slots'. The left panel's per-row blue/pink split (a sequence in flight then its slot idle) and the 'next batch waits' annotation both presuppose row = request/slot.
acceptance_test: Rewrite the caption so the horizontal axis is 'time (measured in decode steps / iterations)' and each row is 'one request (one slot)'; replace 'the step boundaries are staggered across rows' with 'sequence admission/eviction points are staggered across rows (slots)'. After the edit, the caption must agree with the in-figure note ('every shown request...') and with the blue/pink/green structure of both panels; re-read the figure using only the new caption and confirm the discrete panel's trailing pink and the continuous panel's green backfills are explainable.

figure: FIGURE 11.4 (Device visibility is not a validated serving path)
issue: The in-figure qualification-gate box and the caption's italic summary of that gate's requirements do not enumerate the same items. The gate box lists 'Weights + KV + workspace | operators + attention/cache path' and 'Correctness + isolation | collectives (if used) | measured SLO'. Caption italic: 'the gate additionally requires memory residency, operator coverage, request isolation, collectives when used, and a measured SLO.'
